discussion_comments.comment_body: The reveal group does not contain Radix menu content: `DropdownMenuContent` portals under `document.body`. Once a status-bar menu opens and focus/pointer moves into it, these group selectors stop matching and retract the footer. Please retain visibility while any status-bar dropdown is open, with a regression test for that portal-focus path.
